environment.provenance: Workflow-declared benchmark environment; host performance is not normalized.

method.processRegime: fresh app process per call; media prejoined before Answer
method.answerTrigger: PREJOINED plus 150 ms requested delay; actual delay is summarized per path
method.authority: Same live Core-active call plus observed MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION; endpoint observation is descriptive.
method.recording: No observed new pre-answer recording session; active recording observed after authorization.
method.exclusions: Not acoustic output, OS process-launch latency, or FCM delivery latency.
method.timingCaveat: Transport timestamps are first-observed states, not exact handshake completion. Stats polling is 25 ms and the stats cache may be 50 ms; retained per-observation poll/cache and request-to-callback statistics describe additional uncertainty. Callbacks and stats observations are counted separately. Intervals overlap and must not be summed. Missing observations remain null with n=0.
method.comparisonCaveat: Historical Stop2/repeated-process samples use a different regime and cannot establish causal improvement against this baseline.
method.provenance: Commit/run references are supplied by the caller; SHA256 binds exact checked aggregate and summary bytes.
